d: What happens when a five-minute meeting becomes the end of your career? A Reddit post claims 80 Indian customer-service employees at a U.S.-based financial firm were dismissed during a brief Google Meet. Similar reports involving Adidas, Oracle, Better.com, GM, Tesla and Salesforce highlight how layoffs are increasingly delivered through emails, video calls and sudden loss of system access. But behind every “job cut” are people, families, rent, EMIs and futures. Why are companies turning to digital layoffs—and has workplace efficiency come at the cost of human dignity? We examine the…
